book.title: Daily Mail New Cryptic Crosswords, volume 2

clue.text: No beauties among us — that's easily understandable

parts.note: surface reading: a modest group of English people admitting none of them is good-looking
setter's reading: the phrase for clear, simple wording, punned on as homely natives of England

explanation.surface: A self-deprecating group of English folk admit that none of them is a looker.
explanation.walkthrough: Plain English people would be ordinary-looking ones; the phrase PLAIN ENGLISH really means simple, jargon-free language.
explanation.definitionFit: Simple, jargon-free wording is what this phrase describes, so it is language anyone can grasp quickly.

clue.text: European jazz fan regarded as an animal

parts.note: a Pole is a person from Poland
cat is old slang for a jazz enthusiast

explanation.surface: Someone from the Continent who loves jazz is thought of as a beast.
explanation.definitionFit: The polecat is a small carnivorous mammal of the weasel family, so it is a kind of creature.

clue.text: Make better use of meal before one has to speak

indicators.note: making use of something can mean working it into new shape, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the word itself, to be rearranged
the Roman numeral for one
to orate is to make a speech

explanation.surface: Advice to improve a dinner before someone must give a speech.
explanation.definitionFit: To ameliorate is to improve a situation, a formal synonym for making something better.

clue.text: There isn't one loan that can be negotiated, it's thought

definitions.note: the answer is an adjective; the phrase describes something existing only in thought

parts.note: isn't contains the negative not

indicators.note: terms that are negotiated get reworked and rearranged, so these letters change order

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one
the word itself, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A bank manager concedes there is no negotiable credit available, or so people think.
explanation.definitionFit: Notional means existing only as an idea or theory, so it describes what is merely thought rather than real.

clue.text: There isn't a line one can certify

parts.note: isn't contains the negative not
taken as written
RY is the abbreviation for railway, a railway line

explanation.surface: Someone complains that there is no queue or sentence anybody could vouch for.
explanation.definitionFit: A notary public is an official authorised to witness and certify documents, so it is a person who certifies.

clue.text: What fun to be an early riser!

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a bit of fun or a prank
second meaning: a songbird, as in being up with the bird at dawn

explanation.surface: An exclamation of delight at getting up first thing in the morning.
explanation.walkthrough: The bird flies up singing at dawn, and a person who rises early is said to be a lark.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means a carefree prank or spree, and is also the dawn-singing bird or a person who wakes early.

clue.text: Look into shape not finally showing decay

indicators.note: into means one piece goes inside the other
not finally tells us to drop the last letter of the word for shape

parts.note: a square is a geometric shape
lo is an old word meaning look or behold

explanation.surface: An inspector examines a building whose form is beginning to rot.
explanation.definitionFit: Squalor is filthy, wretched neglect, the state of a place left to rot and fall into dirt.

clue.text: Do as you're told and take a tip

definitions.meaning: first meaning: obey instructions given to you
second meaning: act on a recommendation someone offers

explanation.surface: A parent tells a child to obey and heed the advice given.
explanation.definitionFit: To follow guidance is both obeying instructions and heeding a recommendation, two senses of the same phrase.

clue.text: Gather what may be said in church

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a verb, to bring together

definitions.text: what may be said in church
definitions.meaning: second meaning: a noun, a short prayer read at a service

explanation.surface: Someone is told to assemble the words spoken at a church service.
explanation.walkthrough: As a noun the stress moves to the first syllable: a collect is a short set prayer in Anglican and Catholic services.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means assemble or accumulate; as a noun it names a brief liturgical prayer for a particular day.

clue.text: Finished with the tunnelling

definitions.meaning: first meaning: done with something, as in I'm done with him
second meaning: passing from one side to the other of something

explanation.surface: Miners declare they have completed the digging work.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means done or over, and also describes boring from one end of an obstacle to the other.

clue.text: Wanting to be back when hospital attendance isn't required?

parts.note: setter's reading: longing to return to where you live
surface reading: an illness mild enough to be nursed in bed at your own house

explanation.surface: A patient yearns to go back while not needing a hospital stay.
explanation.walkthrough: Split it as HOME SICKNESS: being ill at home rather than in hospital. Read whole, it is the longing for home.
explanation.definitionFit: Homesickness is the ache of missing your house and family while away, a desire to return.

clue.text: Cries out to show anger in support of writing

indicators.note: out can mean disordered or wrong, so the letters are put in a new order

parts.note: the word itself, to be rearranged
taken as written
ire is a literary word for anger

explanation.surface: Protesters shout their fury in defence of the written word.
explanation.definitionFit: An escritoire is a small writing desk with a hinged flap, a piece of furniture that holds up the writer's paper.

clue.text: Fat end cut off fruit

indicators.note: with its end cut off, the last letter of the word is removed

parts.note: plump means fat or rounded

explanation.surface: Instructions to trim the greasy edge from a piece of fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: The plum is a stone fruit, a common orchard crop with smooth purple or yellow skin.

clue.text: Getting ready for quiet departure to make amends

indicators.note: the departure of a letter means it leaves the word entirely

parts.note: preparation is the act of getting ready
p is piano, the musical direction for quiet

explanation.surface: Making preparations for a silent exit in order to apologise.
explanation.walkthrough: The first of the two Ps leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: Reparation is compensation made for a wrong, the act of making up for harm done.

clue.text: Study meeting of workers to back retreat

parts.note: TU is a trade union, an organisation of workers
taken as written

indicators.note: back here means read backwards, so the word for retreat runs right to left

parts.note: a lair is a hideaway or retreat

explanation.surface: A union holds a gathering to support an orderly withdrawal.
explanation.definitionFit: A tutorial is a teaching session with a tutor and a few students, a meeting held for study.

clue.text: Wooden account of what happened

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a chunk of a tree trunk, a thing made of wood
second meaning: a written record, as kept by a ship's captain

explanation.surface: A stilted, lifeless report of events.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wooden' seems to describe the account's style; here it stands alone as a noun meaning a piece of timber.
explanation.definitionFit: A cut length of tree is this word, and so is a ship's or official journal recording events.

clue.text: Suit that takes some beating?

parts.note: surface reading: a set of clothes or a card suit that is very hard to better
setter's reading: the organs that pulse, giving their name to a card suit

explanation.surface: Praise for an outfit or a hand of cards that is hard to surpass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Takes some beating' means is excellent, but the card suit named after the organ really does beat.
explanation.definitionFit: One of the four suits in a pack of cards is named after the organ that pumps blood with a regular pulse.

clue.text: Sound like one of the herd being nasty

definitions.text: Sound like one of the herd
definitions.meaning: first meaning: to moo as cattle do
second meaning: mean or contemptible, as in a dirty trick

explanation.surface: Someone joins the crowd and behaves meanly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One of the herd' suggests a conformist, but here it is a cow.
explanation.definitionFit: Cattle make this mooing noise, and the same word as an adjective means base, mean or dishonourable.

clue.text: She'll triumph as a Communist

parts.note: to win is to triumph
loosely, as in the sense of supposing or provided
Red is the traditional label for a Communist

explanation.surface: A woman will succeed as a Communist politician.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as 'she'll WIN IF RED': she will triumph, as it were, if a Communist. The link of 'as' to IF is loose.
explanation.definitionFit: Winifred is a woman's first name, so the female pronoun stands for her.

clue.text: Send as agent not finally to discourage internal turn-up

indicators.note: internal means placed inside the other word
not finally tells us to drop the last letter of the word for discourage

parts.note: to deter is to discourage

indicators.note: turn means the short word is flipped round

parts.note: taken as written, from turn-up

explanation.surface: A manager delegates someone, though not to put off an unexpected internal development.
explanation.walkthrough: Turn-up looks like a surprise or a trouser hem; it splits into the instruction to turn the word up.
explanation.definitionFit: To depute is to appoint someone to act on your behalf, delegating them as your representative.

clue.text: One joins the cricket club in a game that may be played

indicators.note: joins in a game means going inside it, so these letters sit within

parts.note: polo is a game played on horseback
the Roman numeral for one
CC is the abbreviation for cricket club

explanation.surface: A new member signs up at a sports club where a game is on.
explanation.definitionFit: A piccolo is a small flute, a musical instrument, so it is something one plays.

clue.text: Big pop performance with grotesque carry-on

parts.note: a gig is a live pop concert
an antic is a grotesque or absurd caper

explanation.surface: A huge pop concert featuring outrageous behaviour on stage.
explanation.definitionFit: Gigantic means enormous, a stronger word for large or huge.

clue.text: Awful ire associated with term in the galley

indicators.note: awful suggests something badly done, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: the word itself, to be rearranged
the word itself, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Dreadful fury breaks out among the crew of a rowing ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A trireme was an ancient warship with three banks of oars, a kind of oared galley.

clue.text: Something to be said for appeal to highest authority

definitions.text: Something to be said for appeal to highest authority

parts.note: surface reading: a lawyer's case taken to the top court
setter's reading: words spoken to God, the ultimate authority

explanation.surface: An argument in favour of taking a legal case to the supreme court.
explanation.walkthrough: The highest authority is God, not a court.
explanation.definitionFit: Words addressed to God asking for help are spoken requests to the supreme power.

clue.text: Giving it to a small child causes irritation

parts.note: taken as written
CH is the abbreviation for child

explanation.surface: Handing something to a toddler only annoys them.
explanation.definitionFit: An itch is a tickling skin sensation that makes you want to scratch, a kind of irritation.

clue.text: Making a clergyman talk about noise

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the long word goes around the short one

parts.note: an oration is a formal talk or speech
a din is a loud noise

explanation.surface: A vicar's training includes a lecture on loud sounds.
explanation.definitionFit: Ordination is the ceremony conferring holy orders, by which someone becomes a priest or minister.

clue.text: Depressed by information of low shortage

definitions.meaning: first meaning: feeling low in spirits
second meaning: short by an amount, as in being five pounds under

explanation.surface: Someone is dejected on hearing news of a shortfall.
explanation.walkthrough: The middle words are hard to parse as printed; 'low' is a further sense of the answer, but the clue may be garbled.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means sad or dejected, and also lacking by some amount, as when a team is two goals behind.

clue.text: English shy about record of environmental study

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for English

indicators.note: about means going around, so the word for shy wraps the record

parts.note: coy means bashful or shy
a log is a written record

explanation.surface: A bashful Englishman is reticent about his research notes on nature.
explanation.definitionFit: Ecology is the science of how organisms relate to each other and their surroundings.

clue.text: Errs badly about giving help to attackers

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the jumbled letters wrap the other word
badly means done wrongly, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: the word itself, to be rearranged
aid means help

explanation.surface: Someone blunders by assisting the enemy.
explanation.definitionFit: Raiders are people who make sudden assaults on a place, so they are aggressors.

clue.text: Steps taken to get out of town for some enjoyment

definitions.text: Steps taken to get out of town for some enjoyment

parts.words: Steps taken to get out of town
parts.note: surface reading: measures a city dweller takes to escape to the fields
setter's reading: dance steps of a rural folk dance

explanation.surface: A townie arranges a trip to the fields for fun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Steps taken' sounds like arrangements; they are the dance's footwork.
explanation.definitionFit: A traditional English folk dance, often in lines or sets, performed for fun at rural gatherings.
